prompt: Identify the part with the grammatical error (or 'No error').
sentence: The long-awaited vacation packages offered (A) / by the tourism agency are cheaper (B) / than our competitors. (C) / No Error (D)
options: by the tourism agency are cheaper
explanation: The comparison must be between like things—packages with packages—so it should be 'than our competitors'' (i.e., than those of our competitors), not the competitors themselves.
